english.note: This is the all-purpose casual term for a person who helps someone else.

exampleSentences.english: This is the new assistant we hired.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個係我哋新請嘅幫手。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 san1 cing2 ge3 bong1 sau2

english.note: Use this as the colloquial all-purpose term for a person who helps or something that is useful.

exampleSentences.english: This umbrella is a real helper when it rains, so you won't get soaked carrying it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢把傘真係幫手，落雨嗰陣帶住佢就唔使周身濕。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 baa2 saan3 zan1 hai6 bong1 sau2 lok6 jyu5 go2 zan6 daai3 zyu6 keoi5 zau6 m4 sai2 zau1 san1 sap1

english.note: Use 幫手 for an ordinary person who helps or assists someone, without necessarily implying a subordinate servant role.

exampleSentences.english: I asked a friend to be my servant for the day and help me move some boxes.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我叫咗個朋友做我今日嘅幫手，幫我搬啲箱。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 zo2 go3 pang4 jau5 zou6 ngo5 gam1 jat6 ge3 bong1 sau2 bong1 ngo5 bun1 di1 soeng1

english.note: Use this for an everyday helper or someone brought in to help.

exampleSentences.english: I found a helper to aid me in moving house.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我搵咗個幫手幫我搬屋。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 wan2 zo2 go3 bong1 sau2 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1

english.note: Use this for a friend who is a helpful associate, rather than for an ordinary social friend.

exampleSentences.english: He is a friend who helps out at our company.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 bong1 sau2
